milestones.title: The hosted cryptography inventory records the base and its provider certificate

remediation: The upstream openbao-ubi image is built on RHEL 10, while the fit register describes it as UBI 9 and the SoftHSM2 build stage is UBI 9. Correct the register, and record which OpenSSL FIPS provider certificate applies to the UBI 10 base.
title: The OpenBao base image is UBI 10, not the UBI 9 the register records
